scripts.notprebuild: echo '🔧 Prebuild: Setting up shared folder...' && mkdir -p shared && cp -r ../shared/* ./shared/ 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️  Copy step completed with warnings'
scripts.build: echo '🏗️  Starting TypeScript compilation...' && tsc && echo '✅ TypeScript compilation finished'
scripts.test: npm run build && SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=test-key SUPABASE_SKIP_CONNECTION_TEST=true node --test dist/mcp/*.test.js dist/mcp/machines/*.test.js
